title: The Sanctuary Work
source: User-provided analysis of Sanctuary Timeline (Daily).png and Sanctuary Timeline (Yearly).png; source numbering and interpretations retained.

notes.court: Step 18 is an entrance/courtyard boundary action. Step 24 occurs outside the camp and is grouped here for continuity.
notes.holy: Steps 11–12 follow the diagram’s Holy Place approach grouping; their actions concern the entrance/court. Neither uses the lampstand. Step 19 is a garment transition.
notes.most: Step 5 belongs to the Daily sequence. Steps 13–16 belong to the Yearly sequence. Step 14 has no Aaron counterpart.
notes.daily: Aaron’s “about 6 a.m.” and “most part of the day” describe the symbolic service-day clock, not historical calendar dates.
notes.yearly: AM = anno mundi, year of the world—not a.m. clock time. 6,000/7,000 AM are the source’s schematic framework, not Gregorian predictions. The interval between Steps 23–24 is unspecified.

showbread: Table of showbread: present in the sanctuary, but no numbered action is specified in these diagrams.

steps.title: Enter the gate
steps.aaron: Comes into the courtyard to begin ministry.
steps.christ: Jesus is born.

steps.title: Wash and dress
steps.aaron: Washes body; puts on common priest’s garments to prepare for service.
steps.christ: Baptism.

steps.title: Offer the bull
steps.aaron: Offers a bull for himself and his household before serving the people.
steps.christ: Crucifixion; represented as the bull offering for Himself and His co-laborers.

steps.title: Wash hands and feet
steps.aaron: Cleanses before proceeding inward.
steps.christ: Resurrection; source describes removal of “traces of sin.”

steps.title: Take incense and censer
steps.aaron: Collects incense and censer to carry inward.
steps.christ: Passes through with His own merits.

steps.title: Present blood; acceptance
steps.aaron: Places bull’s blood on the ark/mercy seat and brings incense before God.
steps.christ: Presents His blood; acceptance by God.

steps.title: Return to co-laborers
steps.aaron: Meets his sons; prepares the people’s lamb offering.
steps.christ: Returns to His co-laborers; forty days on earth; represented as the Lamb for the people.

steps.title: Wash again
steps.aaron: Washes hands and feet before high-priestly service.
steps.christ: Divine stature restored to sixteen feet, according to the source.

steps.title: Dress as High Priest
steps.aaron: Dresses for high-priestly service.
steps.christ: Inauguration as High Priest.

steps.title: Pour oil into the lamp
steps.aaron: Supplies the lamp with oil.
steps.christ: Pentecost; pours out the Holy Spirit.

steps.title: Offer incense
steps.aaron: Offers incense during the continuing daily service.
steps.christ: At the first throne, pleading His merits for the people.

steps.title: Blow the trumpet
steps.aaron: Gives the first warning of the Day of Atonement.
steps.christ: First angel’s message preached.

steps.title: Cast lots; Lord’s goat
steps.aaron: Begins the congregation’s offering; common priests leave the court.
steps.christ: Twenty-four elders’ work ends; Jesus represented as the goat for the people, according to the source.

steps.title: Enter with goat’s blood
steps.aaron: Carries the congregation’s offering within the veil.
steps.christ: Enters the Most Holy Place in heaven.

steps.title: Show the law and Sabbath
steps.aaron: No Aaron counterpart is shown.
steps.christ: Stands before the law, showing the Sabbath to believers in 1844.

steps.title: Judgment before God
steps.aaron: Participates in the yearly service before God.
steps.christ: Sits with God as Judge; investigative judgment.

steps.title: Sprinkle blood; complete judgment
steps.aaron: Sprinkles blood on the mercy seat and before the law.
steps.christ: Pleads His blood; sins removed, people sealed, sins blotted from the book.

steps.title: Cleanse the incense altar
steps.aaron: Stops at the altar and cleanses it by blood.
steps.christ: Throws down censer; cleanses Holy Place; close of probation.

steps.title: Place sins on scapegoat
steps.aaron: Transfers sins removed from the sanctuary to the live goat.
steps.christ: Places sins upon Satan.

steps.title: Remove high-priestly robes
steps.aaron: Changes out of the high-priestly garments.
steps.christ: Removes high-priestly robes.

steps.title: Leave the sanctuary
steps.aaron: Comes out in white garments after completing the inward service.
steps.christ: Leaves sanctuary; associated with the plagues in the source.

steps.title: Wash body again
steps.aaron: Washes at the laver following the sanctuary service.
steps.christ: Jacob’s time of trouble; plagues; “cup of baptism.”

steps.title: Offer two rams
steps.aaron: Places the burnt offerings on the fire.
steps.christ: Second Coming of Christ.

steps.title: Burn the fat
steps.aaron: Places the fat on the fire.
steps.christ: End of sinners.

steps.title: Burn bodies outside camp
steps.aaron: Disposes of the bull’s and goat’s bodies outside the camp.
steps.christ: Second fire; New Earth; all trace of sin gone.
